opportunity.title: HHS OPDIV Legacy Application Migration to AWS GovCloud
opportunity.agency: Department of Health and Human Services
opportunity.placeOfPerformance: Rockville, MD (remote work authorized, occasional on-site)
opportunity.description: HHS seeks a Small Disadvantaged Business to migrate three legacy Node.js and Python web applications from an on-premise data center to AWS GovCloud (US-East). The work includes: cloud architecture design, containerization using Docker and ECS Fargate, CI/CD pipeline setup with CodePipeline and CodeBuild, data migration of PostgreSQL databases to RDS, and FedRAMP boundary documentation updates. The contractor must follow AWS Well-Architected Framework principles and produce an as-built architecture diagram and updated system security plan (SSP) artifacts. Security scanning via AWS Inspector and GuardDuty must be enabled post-migration. Period of performance: 8 months. Minimal past performance documentation required given SAT threshold.

profile.name: Frasier Digital LLC
profile.capabilities: Government web modernization, Section 508 accessibility compliance, AI/RAG chatbot development, cloud migration (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government), IT consulting, digital transformation for federal agencies.
